name: Nostr long-form content (NIP-23)
description: Broadcast long-form Markdown content to the Nostr network.
project_description:
With this module you're able to post long-form content events (kinds 30023 and 30024 , see NIP-23 ). The event must have Markdown formatted content. An event can be send to multiple relays. Every client which support reading these event kinds can display your published content. 

 For more info please checkout the README in the code repo.

 Currently only works for a single Drupal user.

 More info about Nostr: https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nostr 

In case you missed it, when the founder of Drupal Dries Buytaert discovered Nostr it was love on first sight .

 Requirements 
 - PHP 8.1+ and the GMP extension - https://www.php.net/manual/en/ref.gmp.php
